sources.snippet: The BGE series models have gained widespread popularity among users and developers due to excellent performance and applicability, with download data far surpassing that of similar models.

sources.title: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: New reranker model: release cross-encoder models BAAI/bge-reranker-base and BAAI/bge-reranker-large, which are more powerful than embedding model. We recommend to use/fine-tune them to re-rank top-k documents returned by embedding models.

sources.title: Devstral Small 2 - 256k context, multimodal, open source
sources.snippet: Devstral Small 2 is Mistral AI's 24B open-weights coding agent model, released December 9, 2025 under Apache 2.0. It scores 68.0% on SWE-bench Verified and supports agentic software engineering tasks, multi-step reasoning, and tool use. Runs on a single RTX 4090 GPU or a Mac with 32GB RAM. Multimodal, with support for image inputs.

sources.title: Welcome to BGE! — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: Want to get familiar with BGE quickly? There are hands-on examples to run for embedder and reranker's inference, evaluation, and finetuning. Unfamiliar with some area, keywords or techniques of retrieval and RAG? We provide tutorials to teach you basic knowledge and coding tips. Interested in research topics that expanding from BGE and retrieval?
